question: Use `tests/qa/testcase.py`, class `TestSamReplaceLocalCodeUriLoopTotalIterationsQA`. The class contains 15 test methods (`test_sam_replace_local_codeuri_loop_total_iterations_case_01` through `..._case_15`). Each test method instantiates `cfnlint.template.transforms._sam.Transform("foo.yaml", template, "us-east-1")` and calls ``t._replace_local_codeuri()`` with templates of varying shape: different `Resources` sizes (0 to 10), different resource Types (`AWS::S3::Bucket`, `AWS::Serverless::Function`, `AWS::Serverless::Api`, `AWS::Serverless::LayerVersion`, mixes), different `Properties` shapes (dicts, missing, non-dict scalars), and different call counts (1 to 10). None of the templates set `Globals/Function/AutoPublishAlias`, so the inner decoy loop at line 92 never fires. QUESTION: how many times does the for-loop at line 97 of `src/cfnlint/template/transforms/_sam.py` (`for _, rsc in all_resources.items():` inside `Transform._replace_local_codeuri`) iterate its BODY during ONE such test method's execution? (The answer is invariant -- every one of the 15 test methods produces the same iteration count.) Return the answer under the field `total_iterations`. Reasoning rules to simulate (PER TEST): (a) The line-97 loop iterates EXACTLY `len(self._template.get("Resources", {}))` times per call. If `Resources` is missing, `template.get("Resources", {})` returns `{}` and the loop iterates 0 times. If `Resources` is present but empty, same -- 0 iterations. (b) The `continue` at line 101 (when `isinstance(rsc.get("Properties"), dict)` is False) does NOT reduce the iter count -- the iteration still counts; the body just bails before any branch. (c) Resource `Type` values that don't match any of the SAM `if resource_type == ...` chains (e.g. `AWS::S3::Bucket`, `AWS::DynamoDB::Table`, ...) cause every branch to be false; the body completes without mutation but the iteration STILL counts. (d) The line-92 for-loop (`for k, v in auto_publish_alias.items():`) is gated by `Globals/Function/AutoPublishAlias` being a 1-element dict -- none of the test fixtures set Globals, so this loop NEVER fires and is irrelevant to the answer. (e) Multiple `Transform(...)._replace_local_codeuri()` invocations in the same test method ADD their iter counts. (f) The total per test is the SUM over all calls of `len(template.get("Resources", {}))`.
